EV_AL01.SPC.よし、おいかけよう！！: All right, let's go after them!!

EV_AL02.SPC.そのこえ…このせかいにくるときの…！: That voice... from when I came to this world...!

EV_GO01.SPC.へ！マヌケなてめぇでも: Heh! Even an idiot like you...
EV_GO01.SPC.少しは手ごたえのあるヤツと: Looks like we might finally get...

EV_GO02.SPC.二人と一人ね！: Two one way, one the other!
EV_GO02.SPC.あんたは『一人』じゃなくて: You don't count as a person!

EV_GO03.SPC.他人のために本気でおこれる: And he really gets angry on other people's behalf.

EV_GO04.SPC.じぶんをだれやと思ってる？: Who do you think I am?
EV_GO04.SPC.チェスの兵隊: When it comes to the Chess Pieces...
EV_GO04.SPC.負けてへんのや！！: ...doesn't want it more than I do!!
EV_GO04.SPC.おれ、だれかしらないのか？: Don't you know who I am?
EV_GO04.SPC.チェスのこま、オルコだぞ！！: I'm Orco of the Chess Pieces!!

EV_GO05.SPC.ヴェストリをおそったのは: You're the one who attacked Vestri...
EV_GO05.SPC.人ころしたのはギロム！！: Girom was the one who killed people!!
EV_GO05.SPC.さてと…あと一人…: Now then... one more to go...
EV_GO05.SPC.ギンタンのほうにいるのかしら？: I wonder if he's over where Gintan went.

EV_GO06.SPC.ヴェストリに住んでたんだ: I used to live in Vestri.
EV_GO06.SPC.なんだ、びっくりさせんなよ！: Oh, don't scare me like that!
EV_GO06.SPC.ぼくたちを助けようとしてくれる: You're all trying to help us...
EV_GO06.SPC.みなさんに…少しでも力になりたくて…: ...so I wanted to do whatever I could to help you...
EV_GO06.SPC.みちのあんないくらいならできると思う: I think I can at least show you the way.

EV_GO07.SPC.いっしょにチェスをたおすんだ！: We're going to beat the Chess Pieces together!

EV_GO09.SPC.そうか、てめぇが話にきく: I see. You're the one I've heard about...
EV_GO09.SPC.こわしたのは、オルコってやつだ: A guy named Orco did the destroying.
EV_GO09.SPC.このふねの中にはありゃしねぇ: But it's not in this ship.
EV_GO09.SPC.はんごろしでゆるしてやるぜぇ: ...and I'll let you off with a beating half to death.
EV_GO09.SPC.<F0><56>ＲＭをさがしにきたんだがよ: ...rumored to be in the underground lake.
EV_GO09.SPC.てめぇ<F0><56>ＲＭひろったか！？: Did you pick up an ÄRM?!

EV_GO10.SPC.助けてほしいのはおまえだろ？: You're the one who needs help!
EV_GO10.SPC.ここから出たいのか…！？）: Does it want to get out of here...?!)

EV_GO11.SPC.かべに穴をあけて…: Make a hole in the wall...
EV_GO11.SPC.つかれてるけど、やるよ！！: I'm tired, but I'll do it!!
EV_GO11.SPC.これで天にのぼることができます: Now we can ascend to heaven.
EV_GO11.SPC.じぶんが、おぶってきたんや！: I carried you out on my back!

EV_JA04.SPC.（オイラがあんなに苦労した: (He dodged Ruga and Garu's attacks so easily...
EV_JA04.SPC.ルーガルーの攻撃を軽くかわした！！）: ...when I had so much trouble with them!!)
EV_JA04.SPC.こんなやつらにオレたちが負けるなんて…！: How could we lose to the likes of them...?!
EV_JA04.SPC.おまえ達に仕事を頼みにきてみれば…: I come to offer you two a job...
EV_JA04.SPC.なんだこのざまは: ...and find you in this sorry state.
EV_JA04.SPC.もう悪さできんようにしてやる！: I'll make sure you can't cause any more trouble!
EV_JA04.SPC.（そうか、封印をといたのはおまえか…）: (I see. So you're the one who broke the seal...)

EV_JA04B.SPC.こっち来てから、ワクワクしっぱなしで: I've been so excited ever since I got here...
EV_JA04B.SPC.その他にも待たせてるヤツがいるんだ: There's someone else waiting for me, too.
EV_JA04B.SPC.だから、帰らなきゃな: So I've got to get home.
EV_JA04B.SPC.オレはこのせかいを歩き回るぞ！: I'm going to travel all over this world!
EV_JA04B.SPC.ジャックのお下がりでわるいけどね: Sorry it's a hand-me-down from Jack, though.
EV_JA04B.SPC.いいんだよ！ギンタちゃんがわたしたちを: Don't worry about that! Just as Ginta...
EV_JA04B.SPC.元のせかいに戻る<F0><56>ＲＭを探す旅だ！！: To find an ÄRM that can take me back home!!

EV_MON01.SPC.あのオヤジただものじゃないね: That old guy is no ordinary man.
EV_MON01.SPC.今からここでのしれんを説明するから: I'll now explain your trial here...
EV_MON01.SPC.ただひたすらゴールをめざす: Simply keep heading for the goal.
EV_MON01.SPC.やることはそれだけぢゃ: That's all you have to do.
EV_MON01.SPC.なんだか、らくしょうっスね: Sounds like a piece of cake.
EV_MON01.SPC.とちゅうでセーブしてやすむことは: You can't save and take a break...

EV_MON02.SPC.ようするに、どんどん進んでいけば: Basically, we just keep moving forward...
EV_MON02.SPC.アラン様からギンタさんに: Ginta, there's a delivery for you...
EV_MON02.SPC.マジックストーンを使うときは、デッキに: When using Magic Stones, don't forget...
EV_MON02.SPC.では、ゴールでまたお会いしましょう: Well then, I'll see you at the goal.

EV_PA01.SPC.オイラ、田舎ものなのでよくは: I'm just a country boy, so...
EV_PA01.SPC.知らないスけど: ...I don't know much about it, but...
EV_PA01.SPC.ちがう所にワープできたりするらしいっス: Apparently they can warp you to other places.
EV_PA01.SPC.ギンタは、たぶんそのディメンションの: Ginta, you were probably warped here...
EV_PA01.SPC.いちばがあって、たいていのものがあるし…: ...there's a market with just about everything...
EV_PA01.SPC.ギンタがいたせかいへかえれる: Maybe we'll find information on an ÄRM...
EV_PA01.SPC.<F0><56>ＲＭを売ってるヤツもいるっス！: ...and there are people selling ÄRM too!
EV_PA01.SPC.<F0><56>ＲＭのじょうほうもあるかも…: ...that can take you back to your world...

EV_ICE01.SPC.よこしまな欲望にみをまかせ: Giving herself over to wicked desires...
EV_ICE01.SPC.それに気付いた私たちは国を出て: When we realized this, we left the country...
EV_ICE01.SPC.しかし、ついにこの: But at last, we were cornered...
EV_ICE01.SPC.よし、まかせろ！！: All right, leave it to me!!

EV_ICE02.SPC.半日でしんぞう止まるはずだよ: ...would have their heart stop within half a day.
EV_ICE02.SPC.他人ごとのようにいいおって！: You talk as though it's none of your concern!
EV_ICE02.SPC.他人ごとだっつーの: It IS none of my concern...
EV_ICE02.SPC.氷の<F0><56>ＲＭつかいでウデのたつ人でも: Even a skilled ice ÄRM user...
EV_ICE02.SPC.あたしはここで<F0><56>ＲＭをさがしてるから: I'll stay here and look for ÄRM.

EV_ICE07.SPC.助けをよびなさい、と…: ...she told me to call for help...
EV_ICE07.SPC.助けるおつもりだったのでしょう: ...so that at least I would be saved.
EV_ICE07.SPC.守らねばならぬ方に: The very person I should protect...
EV_ICE07.SPC.どちらが家臣（かしん）か、わかりません: You'd hardly know which of us is the servant.
EV_ICE07.SPC.ぜったい助けようぜ！！: We're going to save her, no matter what!!
EV_ICE07.SPC.ちょっとしたネイチャー<F0><56>ＲＭじゃな！: It's practically a little Nature ÄRM!

EV_ICE10.SPC.あんた、さいきん…: Lately, you haven't been very popular...
EV_ICE10.SPC.こんなガキにうでおられたヤツがよ！: ...when a kid like this broke your arm!

EV_ICE11.SPC.犬の中からでてきてしまった以上: Now that he's emerged from the dog...
EV_ICE11.SPC.『ギンタ』っていったな？: You said your name was Ginta, right?
EV_ICE11.SPC.犬とオレは合体しているんだ: ...the dog and I are fused together.
EV_ICE11.SPC.犬が３回ねるとオレが出てきて: When the dog sleeps three times, I come out.
EV_ICE11.SPC.オレが１回ねると犬がでてくる: When I sleep once, the dog comes out.
EV_ICE11.SPC.これでスノウの封印をといてやれ: Use it to break Snow's seal.

EV_ICE03.SPC.たいしたことないやつがすこし: a few others who aren't much of a threat.

EV_ICE04.SPC.ここにかんじられる魔力（まりょく）は…: The magical power I can sense here...
EV_ICE04.SPC.このフロアにたっぷり…と: And plenty on this floor, too...

EV_ICE05.SPC.めったにないんだよ、ギンタ: I lend someone a hand, Ginta.
EV_ICE05.SPC.あとはがんばってね<F0><40>: You're on your own from here. Good luck! ♥

EV_ICE06.SPC.がんばってもらわないとね<F0><40>: little Gin will have to do his best. ♥

EV_ICE08.SPC.もう追っ手が来てるかもしれないっス！: Our pursuers might already be here!

EV_ICE09.SPC.おもしろいのがいっしょにいます: He's brought something interesting with him.
EV_ICE09.SPC.この島にある、ときいていたので: I'd heard it was on this island,
EV_ICE09.SPC.ついでにさがそうと思っていたのですが: so I was planning to look for it while we were here.
EV_ICE09.SPC.向こうからきてくれちゃいましたね: But it's come right to us.
EV_ICE09.SPC.それがこんな田舎の島で: And she's hiding on this remote island,
EV_ICE09.SPC.氷づけになって逃げている…: frozen in a block of ice...
EV_ICE09.SPC.あの氷はとかせるんだな！？: You can melt that ice, right!?
EV_ICE09.SPC.火の<F0><56>ＲＭをあずかっております！: I have been entrusted with a fire ÄRM!
EV_ICE09.SPC.別人格になってます: He has a different personality now.
EV_ICE09.SPC.オレっち、６年前の戦争には: I wasn't in the war six years ago,
EV_ICE09.SPC.ちょっとこいつとあそんでいいかな？: mind if I play with this guy for a bit?
EV_ICE09.SPC.とりあえず私のほうがとしうえなので: For the record, I'm older than you,
EV_ICE09.SPC.東京の中学生だ！！: A middle school student from Tokyo!

EV_ICE12.SPC.やっぱり助けにきてくれた！！: I knew you'd come to rescue me!
EV_ICE12.SPC.となりでボーっとしてるボウズだ: the kid standing there in a daze.
EV_ICE12.SPC.いよいよ、チェスの兵隊が: So the Chess Pieces are finally
EV_ICE12.SPC.ほんかくてきにあばれるのですね？: going to unleash their full fury?
EV_ICE12.SPC.いちじ、中止だよ: is on hold for now, too.
EV_ICE12.SPC.ちょうてんに立つのかを！』: at the pinnacle of MÄR Heaven!"
EV_ICE12.SPC.オレっちのみぎうで、おったやつ！: He's the guy who broke my right arm!
EV_ICE12.SPC.なんじゃきさまは！: Who do you think you are!?
EV_ICE12.SPC.…なるほど、それならイアンのうでくらい: ...I see. In that case, breaking Ian's arm
EV_ICE12.SPC.おっちまうかもしれないなぁ…: might be well within his capabilities...
EV_ICE12.SPC.イヤなよかん、するぜ…: I've got a bad feeling about this...
EV_ICE12.SPC.（なつかしいにおい、するはずだぜ…）: (No wonder he has such a familiar scent...)
EV_ICE12.SPC.ちょいとはらごしらえに行くか！: How about we go get something to eat?
EV_ICE12.SPC.犬のなかにいるとラクチンだが: Being inside a dog is easy enough,
EV_ICE12.SPC.はらがへるぜ…: but it sure makes me hungry...

EV_AL02B.SPC.『メルヘヴン』によんだのはオレだ: who summoned you to MÄR Heaven.
EV_AL02B.SPC.『門ばんピエロ』をつかって: I used the Gate Keeper Clown
EV_AL02B.SPC.いせかいの住人をよびだした: to summon someone from another world.
EV_AL02B.SPC.よわいヤツがきてしまうとは…: as weak as you would turn up...
EV_AL02B.SPC.６年まえ、きょうあくな<F0><56>ＲＭを: Six years ago, wielding vicious ÄRM,
EV_AL02B.SPC.チェスの兵隊の中心的じんぶつをたおし: to defeat the central figure of the Chess Pieces
EV_AL02B.SPC.せんそうをおわらせたんだ: and bring the war to an end.
EV_AL02B.SPC.キミと同じ『いせかい』からきた: was a human from another world,
EV_AL02B.SPC.チェスの兵隊のアイツと相打ち…: He and that Chess Piece took each other down...
EV_AL02B.SPC.こんな小さな子供がきてしまった: But instead, I got a little kid like you.
EV_AL02B.SPC.（ジャックをいきなりトリにしたり！: (First he turns Jack into a bird out of nowhere!
EV_AL02B.SPC.人をこどもよばわりしたり！）: Then he calls me a kid!)
EV_AL02B.SPC.いせかいからよんだ以上…: since I summoned you from another world...
EV_AL02B.SPC.マトモにたたかえるようにしないとな: until you can at least put up a decent fight.
EV_AL02B.SPC.おまえが封印をといた<F0><56>ＲＭバッボは: Babbo, the ÄRM whose seal you broke,
EV_AL02B.SPC.チェスの兵隊のかなめ: belongs to the heart of the Chess Pieces:
EV_AL02B.SPC.紳士（しんし）のワシがそんな…！: A gentleman like me would never...!

EV_AL03.SPC.力まかせになぐりやがって…: Punching me with sheer brute force...
EV_AL03.SPC.ギンタにゆび一本ふれるな！！: don't lay a finger on Ginta!
EV_AL03.SPC.死なせるワケにはいかんからな: I cannot allow him to die.
EV_AL03.SPC.ここはパヅタウンのはずれっスよ: We're on the outskirts of Pazu Town.
EV_AL03.SPC.あんなヒヨッコにたおされて！: Getting beaten by a mere fledgling!
EV_AL03.SPC.いまごろおまえはどーなって: who knows what would have become of you...
EV_AL03.SPC.オイラかごの中で見てたっスよ: I saw it all from inside the cage.
EV_AL03.SPC.すなおじゃないっスね、バッボ…: You can't just admit how you feel, can you, Babbo...?

EV_JA01.SPC.オイラん家の畑をこれ以上ーーーーー…: You're not doing any more damage to our field...!
EV_JA01.SPC.そうかいそうかい！: Well, I'm glad you like them!
EV_JA01.SPC.ちがうせかいから来たばっか！: I just got here from another world!
EV_JA01.SPC.ギンタのやつ、畑に入るなり: The moment Ginta stepped into the field,
EV_JA01.SPC.二人で野菜をつくって、それを食べたり: We grow vegetables together, eating some
EV_JA01.SPC.売ったりして生活しているんだよ: and selling the rest to make a living.
EV_JA01.SPC.人狼のとうぞく『ルーガルーブラザーズ』！: The werewolf thieves, the Lugar Brothers!
EV_JA01.SPC.足がふるえて何もできなかった…: my legs shook so much I couldn't do anything...
EV_JA01.SPC.自分の力で道をひらくっス！: I'll make my own way forward!

EV_JA02.SPC.かれは今男になろうとしてる！: He's trying to become a man!
EV_JA02.SPC.おまえも男ならわかるであろう！！: If you're a man too, you should understand!
EV_JA02.SPC.これ以上家の畑をあらすと…！: If you wreck our field any more...!
EV_JA02.SPC.これ以上あらすと…何かくれんのかよぉ！？: If we wreck it some more... what, you'll give us something!?

EV_JA03.SPC.今日はむかつく日だな: Today's really getting on my nerves.
EV_JA03.SPC.そうだな、ころしモードぜんかいで行くか！！: Yeah. Let's go all out and kill them!

FULL_ITM.SPC.マジックストーン１０コずつ入れ中: Adding ten of each Magic Stone.
FULL_ITM.SPC.マジックストーン１０コずつ入れ中 おわり: Adding ten of each Magic Stone: done.

EV_RT01.SPC.それに…こんなに走り回ってもつかれないし: And... I don't get tired even after all this running around.
EV_RT01.SPC.なんか はやく走れてる気がする…！！: I feel like I can run faster, too...!
EV_RT01.SPC.ボッチャン！ずいぶんとゴキゲンそうですが: Young man! You seem to be in quite a good mood.
EV_RT01.SPC.何かたのしいことでもありましたかなー？: Has something nice happened to you?
EV_RT01.SPC.…あったあった！ここに来られたことがな！: ...Yeah, it has! I got to come here!
EV_RT01.SPC.ところで、おねがいがあるのですが…: By the way, I have a favor to ask...
EV_RT01.SPC.今日は日差しがきつくてたまりません: The sun is unbearably strong today.
EV_RT01.SPC.そこから水をくんできてくれませんか？: Could you fetch some water from it for us?

EV_VE01.SPC.水と森の村: A village of water and forests...
EV_VE01.SPC.美しいとこやったのに…: It used to be such a beautiful place...

EV_BA03.SPC.マジックストーンは、魔力のひくいキミでも: Magic Stones can be used even by someone with little magical power like you.
EV_BA03.SPC.使えるべんりな<F0><56>ＲＭってとこね: They're a handy kind of ÄRM.
EV_BA03.SPC.シンクロするまで時間が必要なの: you'll need some time to synchronize with it.

EV_EDO01.SPC.エドにごどうこうねがえませぬか！？: ...or Ed, as you may call me?!

EV_RT03.SPC.他にもある？？見せて見せて！！: Are there others? Show me, show me!!
EV_RT03.SPC.ここを道なりに進めば目的の場所につくよ: Follow this road and you'll get there.
EV_RT03.SPC.ドロシーよ、はじめまして<F0><40>: I'm Dorothy. Nice to meet you. ♥
EV_RT03.SPC.<F0><56>ＲＭも知らないって…: You don't even know what an ÄRM is...
EV_RT03.SPC.<F0><56>ＲＭはね…魔法…といえばそうかな: ÄRMs are... magic, you could say.
EV_RT03.SPC.あたしについてきたら、アゲル<F0><40>: Come with me, and I'll give you one. ♥

EV_GTOB.SPC.見たことも無い虫とかキノコでいっぱいだ！: So many bugs and mushrooms I've never seen!
EV_GTOB.SPC.うん、さっき来たばっかりだ: Yeah, I only just got here.
EV_GTOB.SPC.でも…ずっとあこがれてたせかいなんだ！: But... I've always longed for this world!
EV_GTOB.SPC.ユメに何度も見たくらいに: I've dreamed about it so many times.
EV_GTOB.SPC.そうか…ならばこのせかいを一人で: I see... Then enjoy this world...

EV_GTOB2.SPC.いや、助かった、すまなかったな、ギンタ！: You saved me! Sorry for the trouble, Ginta!
EV_GTOB2.SPC.おまえをワシの家来として: I shall permit you to accompany me...
EV_GTOB2.SPC.これからもオレが守ってやるからな！！: I'll keep protecting you from now on!!

EV_VE02.SPC.とめてもムダなようだな…: I can't stop you, can I...
EV_VE02.SPC.役に立つかどうかわからないが: I don't know if it'll help...
EV_VE02.SPC.ちていこでひろったものなんだが: I found it in the lake.
EV_VE02.SPC.何か、とくしゅな<F0><56>ＲＭがひつようらしい…: It seems you need a special ÄRM...
EV_VE02.SPC.チェスをたおそうとしている…: We're out to beat the Chess...

EV_T4KIL.SPC.ギンタなんかじゃなくて: I wanted him to praise me...
EV_T4KIL.SPC.いけよ: Go on. Get out of here.
EV_T4KIL.SPC.ここの人間を…ヴェストリ地上へ！！: Let's take everyone here... up to Vestri's surface!!

EV_T1KIL.SPC.うでの封印をといた、ということは…: If the arm's seal is broken...

EV_T2KIL.SPC.こんな<F0><56>ＲＭみったこっとな〜いゾっと♪: I've never seen an ÄRM like this! ♪
EV_T2KIL.SPC.もうひとつのとびらもあいているよな！: The other door should be open too!
EV_T2KIL.SPC.のこりのパーツはあたまです！！: The head is the last part!!

EV_T3KIL.SPC.こんなにうまくいくとはなぁ…: I never thought it would go this smoothly...
EV_T3KIL.SPC.うれしい誤算（ごさん）というやつだ: A pleasant surprise, you might say.
EV_T3KIL.SPC.な…なに言ってるんだ？: Wh... What are you talking about?
EV_T3KIL.SPC.あとかたづけは、キチっとしないとな: Now to tie up the loose ends.
EV_T3KIL.SPC.キレイ好きなんだ、オレは！: I like to keep things tidy!
EV_T3KIL.SPC.ひかくてき、よわい魔力（まりょく）でも: Even someone with relatively weak magic...
EV_T3KIL.SPC.いったん、ドロシーをつれてにげるぞ！: We're taking Dorothy and getting out of here!
EV_T3KIL.SPC.チェスをまえにしてにげるだと！？: You'd run away from a Chess Piece?!

G_EV062.SPC.犬の中からだいたい見てたぜ: I saw most of it from inside the dog.
G_EV062.SPC.それで…あのマールってコはともかく…: Well... never mind that boy Marl...
G_EV062.SPC.あの<F0><56>ＲＭ、すごくイヤなかんじがするの！: That ÄRM gives me a terrible feeling!
G_EV062.SPC.よう…てめぇも気付いたようだな: Hey... Looks like you noticed it too.
G_EV062.SPC.今、ワイらがほりおこそうとしてる: That ÄRM we're trying to dig up...
G_EV062.SPC.なんだ、わざわざしらべに: What, you went all the way back...
G_EV062.SPC.もどってたのかよ、はたらきものだな: ...to look it up? How diligent of you.
G_EV062.SPC.そのキモチだけでじゅうぶんよ<F0><40>: Just knowing you care is enough. ♥
G_EV062.SPC.今、おまえのやるべきことはなんだ？: What should you be doing right now?
G_EV062.SPC.よもやゆるすつもりではあるまいな！？: ...let that insolent brat get away with this?!
G_EV062.SPC.バトルに出るパーティーを自由にえらべます: You can now choose your battle party freely.
G_EV062.SPC.練武（れんぶ）の門が追加されました: ...the Martial Arts Gate is now available.
